title: ML-Backend-Codes
summary: A Python backend service offering GAN-based synthetic data generation and quality-report evaluation for tabular datasets. It directly imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata) plus sdmetrics' QualityReport, running them to fit models and score generated data.
evidence: gans/gans.py:32-36 imports CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, QualityReport and instantiates/fits them at lines 251,265,280,326
